$comment: U51 -- widen the /+5V_BARREL neck. Review item 20 (drc-routing), CONFIRMED:
the reviewer's geometry reproduced exactly, 0.620 mm over 7.30 mm at
This is the fuse-to-FET section: F1.2 -> Q2 source, so it carries the ENTIRE
+5V rail -- three panel backlights, the telltales, both CAN transceivers and
the 3V3 buck's input. Confirmed load-bearing by a trunk walk rather than by
eye: blocking this segment disconnects Q2.1/2/3 from F1.
docs/hardware/board3-pcb-layout-guide.md section 3 sizes this exact path at
~1.5-2 A and requires 'pour or >=60 mil'. The copper either side already is:
1.510 and 1.524 mm. Only this 7.30 mm section was left at 24.4 mil, so it is
an isolated neck rather than an undersized rail.
IPC-2221 at 1 oz, external, 10 C rise: 0.620 mm = 1.69 A, 1.524 mm = 3.25 A.
At the guide's own 2 A the neck ran ~15 C; at F1's 3 A hold, ~37 C. Not
dangerous -- which is why this is a widening, not a re-route -- but it is the
one conductor on the rail that fails the project's own written rule.
Geometry is unchanged: same two endpoints, same layer, same net, only the
width. Nothing moves, so nothing else can be disturbed.
IT CANNOT BE 60 mil FOR ITS WHOLE LENGTH, and the first attempt proved it by
shorting. A uniform 1.524 mm was applied and DRC returned shorting_items:
the widened track swallowed Q2 pad 4 (/GATE_BARREL). The pre-check that let
it through had tested pad CORNERS with an early break instead of the pad
shape -- the exact failure the window-query rule in CLAUDE.md describes, made
on the very net it warns about. Measured properly, with each pad as its
EffectivePolygon: Q2.4 is 0.596 mm from the centreline and F1.1 is 0.863 mm,
so a uniform width caps at 0.989 mm.
The constraint is local, though, not global. Clearance profiled every 0.05 mm
along the run gives max half-width 1.121 at 2.50 mm, 0.836 at 3.00, then it
collapses to 0.495 at 6.50 where Q2.4 sits. So the run is split: the first
3.00 mm gets the full 1.524 mm the guide asks for, and the last 4.30 mm gets
0.900 mm, which is what fits past Q2's gate pad with 45 um to spare.
Result at the guide's 2 A: the binding section goes 15 C -> 8 C rise, inside
the 10 C design target, and IPC capacity 1.69 -> 2.22 A. Reaching 60 mil for
the whole length would mean moving Q2 or re-laying its gate escape, which is
a bigger change than the 7 C buys.
NOTE for anyone re-running the clearance sweep afterwards: the board's
tightest pair overall (review item 21, 72 nm of margin over the 0.1016 rule)
is ALSO /+5V_BARREL against /GATE_BARREL -- but it is a different segment,
over by Q2, and this edit does not touch it. Do not read that 72 nm as
something U51 caused.
The delete bbox is deliberately tight on the north-east corner: a 0.02 mm
stub (50.853,123.500)->(50.840,123.520) shares the neck's endpoint and must
survive, so the box stops at x=50.845.

steps.step: 1/1  /+5V_BARREL fuse-to-FET: 0.620 -> 1.524 mm, tapering to 0.900 past Q2.4
